name: Uldaman Reagent Run
summary: Ghak Healtouch asks you to gather magenta fungus caps from Uldaman for his alchemical study. He plans to make you a greater mender's potion in return.

sections.title: A New Fungus
sections.body: Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar has heard of magenta fungus caps growing in clusters deep in the Uldaman dig site. He wants to study their possible use in alchemy, and asks you to bring him a dozen caps. The clusters may release poisonous spores if disturbed.

faq.q: Who wants the magenta fungus caps?
faq.answer: Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar asks you to bring him a dozen magenta fungus caps for alchemical study.

faq.q: Where do magenta fungus caps grow?
faq.answer: The known clusters grow deep in the Uldaman dig site. Ghak has heard they may grow elsewhere, but Uldaman is the only place he knows.

faq.q: Why does Ghak want the caps?
faq.answer: Ghak wants to study the magenta fungus caps for a possible use in alchemy.

faq.q: What danger do the clusters pose?
faq.answer: The clusters may spew poisonous spores if disturbed.

faq.q: What does Ghak offer in return?
aliases: what do I get from Ghak
faq.answer: Ghak says he will make you a batch of his greater mender's potion.
